methods_quotes.q: Release as a non-Ebola patient was based on a patient having two consecutive negative Ebola RT-PCR tests at least 72 hours apart.
a unique identifier was created using a patient's initials, sex, age, and home location to link multiple specimen records
Test week was based on when the first specimen was taken.
Laboratory results are calculated per patient by week of first positive test performed.
